name: travel-research
description: Interactive travel-planning companion — triages booked vs research-needed, uses Google Maps MCP and parallel sonnet/haiku teammates to build curated Ideas.md + per-category Findings notes. Outputs land in an Obsidian/PARA vault; see config.example.md for the placeholders to fill in.

wikiRoot.title: Wiki root path
wikiRoot.description: Relative or absolute path to your Obsidian vault root (e.g. 'Wiki' or '~/Documents/MyVault').

tripsBase.title: Trips folder
tripsBase.description: Path under WIKI_ROOT where trip project notes live (e.g. '02-Projects/Trips').

projectsBase.title: Projects folder
projectsBase.description: Folder name for defined-outcome projects at the vault root, used when updating the projects index (e.g. '02-Projects'). Vanilla PARA users can use 'Projects'.
